title: Translation
description: Doctors dictate in their native language, openDox provides a translation into this instance's language. The original stays the transcript.
purposeHint: Off by default. The translation is a machine draft and must be compared with one's own dictation (intended purpose).
targetHint: This is the transcription language under Services → Whisper / ASR.

accessHints.selected: Released per user under Users → Edit.
accessHints.all: Every logged-in user can choose a dictation language.

languagesHint: Users can dictate in these languages. The instance's own language is not offered.
invalidCode: Please enter a two-letter ISO code, e.g. fi
